newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany and Russia to cooperate on air safety.
newsitem.headline: Germany and Russia to cooperate on air safety.

text.p: Germany and Russia will cooperate more closely on questions of air safety in future, the German transport ministry said.
The two countries' civil aviation authorities have agreed to exchange safety-related information regularly and set up procedures to cope with safety problems, a ministry statement said.
Passenger travel and freight transport between Germany and Russia have grown considerably since a 1993 air accord between the two countries, the ministry said.
In 1996, passenger traffic rose 15 percent to 1.2 million travellers and services were now offered by some 45 airlines, including 40 Russian carriers, mostly in charter traffic.

The new safety cooperation was a sensible step in view of this growth and a common concern for safe operations of civil aircraft, the transport ministry said. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
